summary: Not sure a dominant vendor is required pushing specific protocols is needed. In fact I think that is the enemy. 2002(4?)-2018 stank for the blogosphere because large corporate silos and search turned their back on html and open standards and started to push their own protocols.

body_html: Not sure a dominant vendor is required pushing specific protocols is needed. In fact I think that is the enemy. 2002(4?)-2018 stank for the blogosphere because large corporate silos and search turned their back on html and open standards and started to push their own protocols.
